intro.title: Read: Gus the Dragon
intro.say: Gus is a friendly dragon who lives on a hill. Listen to the story, and read along. Tap Start.

pages.text: Gus was a big dragon. Gus was not bad.
Gus sat on an egg. The egg was hot.
Kit and Tam ran up to Gus. Tam had a bell.
Crack! A tiny dragon got out of the egg.
Gus was so glad. Kit and Tam got a big hug.

words.mean: An egg is where a baby bird, or a baby dragon, comes from.
A bell rings when you shake it. Ding!
A hug is when you put your arms around someone you love.

clues: Kit and Tam got a big hug.
questions.clue: Kit and Tam got a big hug.
questions.say: Is Gus a kind dragon? Yes, or no?

questions.q: Why did Gus sit on the egg?
How did Gus feel at the end?
clues: Kit and Tam ran up to Gus.
questions.say: How did Gus feel at the end? Happy, or cross?
